definition: This dimension controls the extent to which crafting is restricted by player skills or abilities, varying from completely skill-based systems to those that allow crafting without any prerequisites. It influences player progression and the importance of skill development in crafting.
exclusion_criteria: Crafting is solely based on available materials without any skill requirements.
Crafting options are freely available from the start without progression barriers.
inclusion_criteria: Players must achieve specific skill levels to unlock certain crafting recipes.
Crafting success rates depend on the player's skill level or attributes.
title: Crafting Skill Gating
